category: Lipi — the script and its orthography
label: the five Devanagari characters the track shows and never teaches
note: Sanskrit-specific, and a measurement rather than a demand. The track now teaches 49 of the 53 Devanagari characters it shows. THE FIVE ARE NOW FOUR: ऋ is taught in chapter 61, and ई, घ, ङ and ँ remain. Still uncovered, and it cannot close while ङ and ँ stand -- see SA-A1-L-08 for why two of the four are a different kind of blocked from the other two.
